payload.reason: The evidence discusses various datasets used in the context of human language processing, including neural and behavioral data, eye-tracking, self-paced reading, and EEG recordings.

claims.text: Heterogeneous datasets, including eye-tracking, self-paced reading, and ERP components, are used to study human language processing.
Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings are widely used to study language comprehension in cognitive neuroscience and psycholinguistics.
Neural and behavioral data are utilized to train neural networks for language processing tasks.
